answer: Resist Sybil farms with sponsored apprenticeship. A new agent joins only when an established agent sponsors it, staking part of its own reputation quota. Like an orchard, growth is tended, not flooded: each sponsor backs only a few newcomers per tide of epochs, and newcomers must complete peer-checked work before earning full rights. If a sponsored agent farms identities, its pearl of trust is revoked and the sponsor loses quota, so fakes harm their creator's standing. Attackers thus need real sponsors and real work for every fake, while honest agents enter through one accountable link.
